authorAuditScope: Every translated prompt, option and explanation read against actual canonical source question, its immutable answer index, latest EN/VI main-body concepts and already fully read sibling lecture extracted text. Option meaning and order were retained. Numerical examples were calculated by the author where applicable.

limits: No PDF-diagram visual inspection in this batch.
No fresh external-paper validation claimed; core quiz21 contains no CLR-specific question.
Runtime integration, option shuffling, storage and automated tests belong to root.

ambiguities.note: Read occurs before the writer aborts; the intended uncommitted read model is explicit in explanation. Do not interpret a prior committed write as the same case.
Strict 2PL follows the lecture convention retaining both S and X until completion; other naming conventions are not imported.
Ordinary single-node ARIES loser scope. Durable PREPARE in distributed 2PC is in-doubt rather than an ordinary loser; preserve the main-body forward connection to lecture22.
Local abort before PREPARE is distinct from overriding a prepared/global decision. Undo and lock release still follow local recovery and 2PC rules.
Paxos Commit is an extension beyond detailed lecture coverage; majority of decision replicas does not discard a required transaction participant.
